US Senator Warns of Sanctions on Nations Aiding Iran After Modi-Pashinyan Meet

US Senator Marco Rubio has warned that countries aiding Iran could face sanctions. This statement followed a meeting between Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan. The meeting between Modi and Pashinyan occurred in India. Rubio's warning was reported by Indian media outlets. The specific context of the Modi-Pashinyan meeting and its relation to Iran was not detailed in the provided coverage.
